admission.justification: Spans override parsing, stat-cached repository LanguageSet resolution, custom shared-library loading, and all live production citation consumers, guarded by four end-to-end and security-boundary tests.

applicability: Optional repository-root languages.json and user-settings languages overrides, custom local tree-sitter library loading, and repository_language_set_scope binding across production read, write, conversion, currentness, reference, and review paths.
conditions: parse_language_overrides rejects unknown keys, forbidden URL keys, remote URLs, and reserved .lean claims in both repository and user layers.
repository_language_set validates enable/disable/suffix/glob target ids, refuses custom ids shadowing catalog entries, and stat-caches sets by config and custom artifact mtimes/sizes.
Custom local libraries load via ctypes/PyCapsule with ABI 13-15 checks and hash binary and query contents into extractor_version.
Production write, conversion, currentness, reference-state, and read paths bind repository_language_set_scope while honoring explicit language_set_scope overrides.
exclusions: Legacy Format 1 conversion retains its pinned format byte contract while using the repository LanguageSet for live symbol resolution.
statement: Optional per-repo languages.json and user settings support ambiguous-suffix/glob overrides, validated enable/disable controls, and local custom tree-sitter library registration (refusing catalog-id shadowing, unknown ids, remote URLs, and .lean overrides) with ABI 13-15 validation, binary/query content hashing into EXTRACTOR_VERSION, and live binding across production read, write, conversion, currentness, reference, and review-memo paths.
title: Local-only languages.json overrides and custom libraries bind live seams
